quantile: numpy quantile method=hazen (MATLAB prctile midpoint empirical convention)

e3.event_interval: closed [start,end] at range epochs, matching existing injector
e3.detection: first upward crossing of max(Cplus,Cminus)>=5 within fault interval; pre-existing threshold state separate
e3.confirmed_alarm: first alarm rising edge within fault interval; pre-existing alarm separate
e3.isolation: first actual admission true-to-false transition on fault edge within fault interval; pre-existing isolation separate
e3.recovery_time: first epoch of 3 consecutive observable admitted healthy epochs after event end, all 3 within observation horizon
e3.recovery_population: events with actual isolation during their active interval, including separately flagged pre-isolated events
e3.recovery_censor: next same-edge event, run end, or first unobservable epoch before stable recovery, if earlier than 30 s horizon
e3.recovery_failure: full 30 s observation with no 3-epoch stable admission
e3.healthy_denominator: observable non-fault leader-follower edge epochs at t>=16; includes residual alarm/isolation after faults
e3.healthy_new_events: state rising transitions at healthy epochs; residual carryover occupancy reported separately using latest episode onset label
e3.state_figures: all seeds retained; main illustration fixed before evaluation, no outcome-based seed choice

geometry: all update epochs: leader LOS rank and condition, range limits, graph connectivity; initial-source nested identities
failure_policy: preserve raw failed attempt and reason; never convert missing delays to zero or discard unsuccessful seeds
git_policy: local only; no GitHub push authorized
